beginner.title: Tabata Foundation

structure.format: Tabata — 20s work / 10s rest × 8 rounds per station

beginner.scaling: Step jacks instead of jumping, knee push-ups, reduce squat depth
beginner.coaching_cue: Push the 20s — the 10s is yours, not a head start on the next round.

beginner.title: Run The Clock
beginner.scaling: Replace sprint with brisk walk, reduce rounds to 5
beginner.coaching_cue: Sprint pace should be uncomfortable, not unsustainable — find the edge and hold it.

beginner.title: The 12
beginner.scaling: 8 squats + 2 burpees, knee push-ups, reduce sit-up to crunch
beginner.coaching_cue: Finish each minute with at least 10 seconds spare — if you can't, reduce the reps now.

beginner.title: Step Up
beginner.scaling: Air squat instead of jump squat, march in place instead of high knees
beginner.coaching_cue: Land every jump squat softly — flat-foot landings send the impact straight to your knees.

beginner.title: Short Ladder
beginner.scaling: Step burpee, air squat instead of squat jump, cap at rung 3 if needed
beginner.coaching_cue: Breathe at the top of every burpee — it costs one second and saves the entire set.

beginner.title: Station Break
beginner.scaling: Knee push-up, reduce step height, plank instead of hollow body
beginner.coaching_cue: Every station is a clean start — reset your breathing between stations, not mid-exercise.

beginner.title: Double AMRAP

structure.goal: Match or beat AMRAP 10 round count in AMRAP 5

beginner.scaling: Step jacks, knee push-ups, squat pulse instead of hop
beginner.coaching_cue: Track your round count in AMRAP 10 — the AMRAP 5 score tells you how well you paced.

beginner.title: Effort Ladder
equipment: none — outdoor, treadmill, or open space
beginner.scaling: 7/10 = brisk walk, 9/10 = fastest walk possible, reduce to 4 rounds
beginner.coaching_cue: 9/10 effort is the fastest you can sustain for 60 seconds — not a 5-second sprint.

beginner.title: Push–Pull Tabata Pairs

structure.format: Tabata pairs — 20s on / 10s off × 8 rounds per pair

pairs.format: Alternate exercises each round × 8 total rounds
Alternate exercises each round × 8 total rounds

beginner.scaling: Knee push-up, bench dip, static lunge
beginner.coaching_cue: In Tabata, consistent reps across all 8 rounds beats blowing up in round 1 — start at 70%.

beginner.title: Breathless 15

structure.rest: Only when needed — rest as little as possible

beginner.coaching_cue: Breathe between movements, not mid-rep — broken rhythm costs more time than a 10-second breath.
